chunks: And from him, from Ali ibn Asbat, from Al-Hasan ibn Al-Jaham who said:

A man asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about the Reappearance (Al-Faraj), so he asked: Do you want a detailed account or shall I summarize it for you? He said: I want you to summarize it for me. He said: When the standards of Qays move in Egypt and the standards of Kinda in Khurasan. Or he mentioned other than Kinda.
ai.seo_question: What are the early signs of the Reappearance of Imam Mahdi according to Imam Musa al-Kadhim?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Tusi's *Kitab al-Ghayba*, Imam Musa al-Kadhim (a.s.) identifies the mobilization of the standards of Qays in Egypt and Kinda in Khurasan as key geopolitical precursors to the Reappearance. This specific mention of tribal alliances in these strategic regions underscores the global scale of the preparatory phase, linking historical tribal dynamics to the eschatological timeline recognized in Shia scholarly tradition.
